description: Proposed upstream edits to OSM relation 4256077 (首都高速中央環状線). The relation is role-less, so graph-builder derives the inner/outer carriageway split from the verified-bound C2 ramp evidence plus the ring geometry; with the corrected 王子北 binding (data/osm-ramp-bindings.json) that split labels all 2,479 relation mainline edges, 1,197 inner and 1,252 outer. This file writes those labels out as roles so the relation carries the directions itself. It is not applied to the release fixture; scripts/apply-osm-relation-repairs.py verifies it on a copy of the snapshot (docs/c2-route-design.md 段13).
humanReviewRequired: The setMemberRole entries are the labels of the corrected split (official ramp directions plus geometry pairing), not a surveyed direction sign. scripts/audit-c2-carriageway-labels.py confirms them against the independent anchor set: 68 ways agree, 1 disagrees (the 大井JCT link way 331692346, where the two carriageways share coordinates in tunnel). A mapper should spot-check the 王子 to 江北 stretch and 大井JCT.

The four removeMemberWay entries have no labelled C2 mainline edge because the relation walk never reaches them (ramps and JCT links). Assigning a direction is preferred over dropping a member when the way really is C2 mainline.
No shipped C2 pair crosses the changed stretch; the three pairs keep the same mandatory lap hash.

verification.appliedToSnapshot: python3 scripts/apply-osm-relation-repairs.py --osm fixtures/osm/shutoko-all.json --repairs data/osm-relation-repairs.json --out /tmp/shutoko-repaired.json then run graph-builder on it

baseline.splitBug: the 王子北 binding pointed at a 川口線 ramp 1.6 km from the C2 mainline, which seeded the outer carriageway eastbound chain (44209387 / 780870438 / 44211094) as inner

verification.after: the release fixture itself is corrected (graph-builder pairing fill plus the 王子北 binding fix), so this file is the changeset that follows it

labelAudit.openDisagreement: way 331692346 at 大井JCT: the split says outer, the anchor set says inner; the two carriageways share coordinates in tunnel so 2D geometry cannot separate them
